title: Best and worst movies and TV shows of 2023

commenti.body:
I do not understand the love for ATSV. Obviously the animation is incredible, but the movie is aight at best. Somehow it felt like we watched 2 movies but only half a movie at the same time. The movie lingers for so long on some things and then zips through other points at warp speed. I can’t stand how often the movie comes to a screeching halt for the characters to literally narrate what they think to the audience or the amount of lectures one character gives to another. 

Peter B. Parker who was the heart and soul of the first film was essentially written out of this film and for the few moments that he was in the film his character was completely assassinated because regardless of consequences the Peter B from the last movie wouldn’t betray Miles the way this new guy did. The more I talk about this movie the less I like it. And it sucks because I love Spiderman and ITSV was an awesome movie. But ATSV is an ok movie on its best day, definitely not even close to some of the other releases of this year. And nowhere near the top 25 movies of all time letterboxd is such a joke lmao
